description: One look's defaults and the ONLY style controls its design responds to: `controls` [{ key, type, min/max/options, default, dependsOn }] and pacing `settings` (maxWordsPerCard, pauseMs, gapBehavior...). Use it to turn a request like "make the highlight pink and put captions higher" into overrides, e.g. { "active.color": "#FF3366", "position.y": 0.6 }. Keys not listed here are rejected.
